periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonally oriented downward toward the snout at approximately a 45-degree angle relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid; the major axis length is approximately twice the width of the minor axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: The patch exhibits a clear downward and forward taper, concentrating the visual mass toward the inferior-anterior margin.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow and wide U-shaped curve along the posterior margin of the band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The band occupies approximately 25 percent of the visible vertical height of the torso at the lateral shoulder junction.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are separated by a distinct white cranial gap approximately equal to the horizontal width of a single ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the pinnae are smoothly convex and rounded.

other_distinctive_markers: The pelage on the lower back and hindquarters displays a prominent brownish-red tint contrasting with the white fur of the neck and upper back.
